title: Run a PCSX2 batch launch test without the main window
summary: Use `-batch` or `-nogui` for a controlled automation test, remembering that `-nogui` implies batch mode and may exit when emulation shuts down.

Run a PCSX2 batch launch test without the main window

blocks.text: PCSX2 documents `-batch` as enabling batch mode and exiting after shutdown; `-nogui` hides the main window and implies batch mode. These options are for an intentional scripted launch, not for ordinary interactive play. Test them with a safe homebrew or a game you own, and keep a normal interactive shortcut available.

Use a trusted local script and a lawful game image or personal homebrew file. Keep the command’s working directory and data-folder arguments explicit. Do not run unattended on a long session: a script may close PCSX2 when its process ends. Make sure important desktop work is saved and that you know how the test will terminate.

items: 1. Copy the known-good PCSX2 command into a temporary script or terminal command.
2. Add `-batch` before the boot filename; use `-nogui` only if you deliberately want no main window.
3. Start with a brief, known-safe boot test and observe the process from the terminal or script runner.
4. Close emulation using its supported exit path and wait for the process to finish.
5. Confirm that the batch process exits as documented.
6. Repeat without `-nogui` if you need to observe a window while retaining batch shutdown behavior.

blocks.text: Pass when the intended title or test starts, the process closes after emulation shuts down, and your ordinary shortcut remains interactive. If you cannot see the emulator, verify the command line and process state from the shell; do not force-kill it while it may be writing saves.

items: Process exits immediately: inspect the command for a missing image path or quoting error.
Window is hidden unexpectedly: remove `-nogui`; it implies batch mode.
The script leaves PCSX2 running: confirm the emulation shutdown event occurred and check process state.
A save is incomplete: do not automate a forced close; repeat with a normal shutdown and verify the save in-game.

blocks.text: Stop the script after PCSX2 exits, remove `-batch` and `-nogui` from the copied command, and return to the ordinary interactive shortcut. Do not terminate an active emulator process as a substitute for its normal shutdown.
